summary.text: Kelvin Lawrence, a Democrat, has represented District 69 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 5, 2014, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, his professional experience includes serving as mayor of Hayneville, Alabama, working as a home builder, and owning several Subway franchises.
